products.name: Workshop — Advanced KQL for SecOps — Commercial
products.short_description: Level up your team on Advanced KQL for SecOps — a structured enablement workshop with concepts, hands-on labs, and a take-home runbook.
products.description:
Level up your team on Advanced KQL for SecOps — a structured enablement workshop with concepts, hands-on labs, and a take-home runbook.

Tools only pay off when the team can drive them. This workshop enables your admins/SOC on Advanced KQL for SecOps: how it works, the console and workflows, and guided hands-on labs — KQL fundamentals to advanced joins/aggregations; hunting patterns across Defender XDR + Sentinel; building detections and workbooks. Adjacent to the THREATHUNT hunt-library product (this is skills/labs, that is a hunt program) — so the team operates it confidently instead of guessing.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • KQL fundamentals to advanced joins/aggregations
  • hunting patterns across Defender XDR + Sentinel
  • building detections and workbooks. Adjacent to the THREATHUNT hunt-library product (this is skills/labs, that is a hunt program)
  • Guided hands-on labs and sample queries
  • Take-home runbook + knowledge-check

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A team that confidently operates Advanced KQL for SecOps — concepts internalized, labs completed, and a runbook to keep.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WSKQL-Discovery.ps1 — inventory workshop readiness for Advanced KQL for SecOps (read-only)
    • WSKQL-Report.ps1 — report cohort progress and per-lab result summaries (read-only)
    • WSKQL-RunLab.ps1 — run a chosen lab query from WSKQL-Labs.kql read-only (Defender advanced hunting)
    • WSKQL-Validate.ps1 — run the workshop pass/fail gates and score the knowledge-check (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
